title: Upgrading DSH silently disables version-mismatched profile plugins

reported.symptom: hooks stopped firing (delete guard, per-prompt routing note, post-edit structure check); the row mounted in cordis.patch.yml never loaded; nothing in the UI
reported.runtime_trace: di_loader_list reported phase=no-fiber disabled=true; the only explanation was one stderr line: 'dsh: disabling profile plugin row ... incompatible with dsh ...'
user_hypotheses: absolute path instead of a relative module specifier
move the row to the end of the patch file
remove the plugin's inject declaration (this one broke the runtime and needed manual recovery)
reported.root_cause: the row's module pins exact @deepseek-ai/dsh-* peers on 0.2.1-rc.2; the running build is 0.2.1-rc.3, so admission disables the row

deviations: bundles omitted: the report is about one row mounted in cordis.patch.yml, so dsh-base/dsh-web-app are left out to keep the composition minimal
node_modules is reconstructed from the real published manifests (npm registry), not a full dependency install
